purpose: Attempt to falsify the mechanism claim before the primary result is trusted. Controls are executed as PART OF THE SAME authorized experiment, are NOT alternate strategies, and are NEVER promotable.

global_rules.gate_set_applied_to_controls: the IDENTICAL G1-G11 gate set and the identical estimator conventions (ARC03_STATISTICAL_GATES.json)
global_rules.control_evaluation_conventions: every control is evaluated on ITS OWN trade set with the SAME cost model (primary 10 bps), the SAME 0/10/20/40 bps scenarios, and the SAME frozen seeds
global_rules.if_any_required_control_satisfies_ALL_cr: MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIED => FINAL_STATUS = DISCOVERY_FAIL (terminal). No retuning of the primary based on control results is permitted.
global_rules.a_control_that_fails_at_least_one_critic: does NOT falsify the mechanism and does not affect the primary verdict

controls.name: reversed direction
controls.falsification_question: Is the contrarian direction load-bearing, or would trading WITH the failed push also appear to work?
controls.executable_definition: Take the PRIMARY signal set unchanged (same signal bars, same entry times, same exit times). Set direction = with-the-push: an up-push signal becomes LONG instead of SHORT, a down-push signal becomes SHORT instead of LONG. Same costs, same funding accounting, same gates.
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the reversed direction satisfies all critical gates the reversal claim is not identified and the ARU mechanism ('urgent liquidity takers pay') is refuted

controls.name: displaced entry (destroyed causal alignment)
controls.falsification_question: Is the edge specific to the immediate aftermath of the shock bar, or is it a generic time-of-day / slow drift effect that any displaced entry would capture?
controls.executable_definition: Take the PRIMARY signal set unchanged. Displace the entry by exactly +HOLDING_BARS = +12 bars (60 minutes) relative to the primary entry: entry_time_control = primary_entry_time_ms + 3600000; exit_time_control = entry_time_control + 3600000 (the same 12-bar hold). The rule, the signal bars and the thresholds are untouched; only the shock-to-holding-window alignment is destroyed.
controls.symmetric_negative_displacement: NOT ADMITTED: advancing the entry by -12 bars would place the entry before the decision instant and therefore violate the PIT contract. The control is deliberately one-sided; this is a causal limitation, not a design choice that can be revisited post hoc.
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the displaced entry satisfies all critical gates the effect is not tied to the shock aftermath

controls.name: participation component removed
controls.falsification_question: Does the abnormal-PARTICIPATION condition add anything, or is this merely a range/exhaustion reversal pattern?
controls.executable_definition: Re-generate the signal set with the participation-shock condition REMOVED: a signal requires ONLY EXCURSION_RECORD(t) AND EXHAUSTION(t) (range record against the same 30 same-slot references, plus strict majority retracement). The volume record is neither required nor consulted. Direction, entry, exit, holding, costs, funding accounting and the gate set are identical to the primary.
controls.note_on_trade_set: this control necessarily produces a DIFFERENT (larger) trade set; it is an isolated experimental comparator, never a modification of the primary signal set, and its trades can never be merged into or substituted for the primary trade set
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the participation-free variant satisfies all critical gates then participation is not the identifying component and ARC-03 collapses into a generic mean-reversion claim

controls.name: deterministic sign-flip null
controls.falsification_question: Would a purely mechanical sign artifact of this trade set satisfy the frozen gate set?
controls.executable_definition: Take the PRIMARY realized net trade returns at PRIMARY_COST_BPS in the frozen emission order. Using rng = random.Random(20260915), for each trade in order compute flipped_i = net_return_i * (+1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1). Evaluate the FULL critical gate set (including the bootstrap and permutation gates, which use their own frozen seeds) on the flipped series.
changes: the sign of each realized net trade return
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the flipped series satisfies all critical gates the gate set is not discriminating and no ARC-03 result could be trusted
